title: Build agent-sidebar tmux TUI
description: A tmux sidebar that tracks coding agent status via signal files and pane polling. See docs/architecture.md for full design.

history.note: All 9 sub-sagas completed: scaffolding, tmux module, agent model, signal files, basic TUI, interactions, git diff stats, pane content fallback, and polish. agent-sidebar is a functional tmux TUI for tracking coding agents.

title: Scaffolding: Cargo project + CLI + basic app state

history.note: Completed scaffolding: Cargo project with ratatui, crossterm, tokio, clap, serde, chrono, notify, anyhow. Basic App state, event loop, and UI rendering working. Demo agents added for testing.

history.note: Completed agent model + discovery: AgentType enum (Opencode, ClaudeCode, Aider, Generic), AgentStatus enum, Agent struct. AgentDetector trait with detect() and parse_status(). OpencodeDetector implementation. AgentRegistry with pluggable detectors. Integrated with App pane discovery.
Agent model complete: AgentType, AgentStatus, Agent struct. AgentDetector trait with OpencodeDetector. AgentRegistry for extensible detection. Integrated with tmux pane discovery.

history.note: Fixed sidebar not moving on window switch. title: Fix worktree detection: use ctx.worktree and signal-based working_dir
description: Worktrees not showing in sidebar because: 1) Plugin ignores ctx.worktree and only sets currentWorktree on file.edited events, 2) Sidebar uses stale tmux pane_current_path instead of signal-provided worktree. Fix both paths.

history.note: Root cause: Plugin initialized currentWorktree=null and only set it on file.edited events (which may not fire). Sidebar used stale tmux pane_current_path via working_dir. Fix: 1) Plugin uses ctx.worktree as initial value + extracts file paths from tool args (read/edit/write) to update worktree on tool.execute.before. 2) Sidebar updates agent.working_dir from signal worktree path, and update_worktrees() no longer clears signal-set worktree values.
